# AI-frygt og Europas techproblem m. Løvens Hule-investor

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-10-06  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The Danish Store Penge episode starts with markets: they are steady despite soft US jobs data and high oil prices, rates and inflation are the main drivers, and French bond yields are under stress. Gains are concentrated in tech and AI, while industrial and consumer stocks are weak. Most of the episode covers Anthropic's leaked IPO prospectus, how fast AI revenue is growing, compute as the bottleneck, AI safety and regulation, and Europe lagging in frontier AI. VC guest Nikolaj Nyholm then talks about investing at the venture fund Dreamcraft and what the esports boom taught him. The hosts stay bullish on the broader AI complex, prefer broad exposure over picking a single winner, and are mixed on Europe.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

AI complex expected to keep performing on explosive demand. Nvidia leads in GPUs, but hosts favour broad exposure over picking one winner.

#### Reasoning

Host Joachim says the leaked Anthropic numbers confirm massive compute demand. He expects the whole AI complex to keep performing, with hyperscalers and chipmakers capturing the spending. He notes Nvidia's leading GPU position but warns that many firms are building their own chips, so the winner is uncertain. His suggested trade is broad AI exposure, not a concentrated Nvidia bet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if custom in-house chips erode Nvidia's GPU share
- if AI compute demand or capex growth slows
- if AI regulation tightens materially

> *"Nvidia har den bedste markedsposition på GPU'er, men vi ved også, at der er rigtig mange, der prøver at bygge deres egen GPU'er. Jeg tror i virkeligheden, at traden her, det er at købe relativt bred eksponering mod..."*
